title: Action Intent Schema (AIS v1)
description: XAIR action intent: a command together with the temporal bounds and context assumptions under which it may be released. Every field below is enforced or recorded by the XAIR runtime; unknown fields are rejected (fail closed). Versioning and compatibility rules: docs/AIS.md.

id.description: Unique intent identifier; duplicates within the retention window return the retained record (idempotency) and are never released twice.

source.description: Producer class, recorded for audit and used as a tie-break in batch conflict resolution. Not authenticated (see the trust model in docs/AIS.md).

timestamp_decision.description: Decision instant t_d (ISO 8601, with offset); anchor of every age check.

freshness_window_ms.description: Maximum age (ms since timestamp_decision) at validation (t_v). An older intent is revoked without evaluating its predicates.

deadline_ms.description: Maximum age (ms since timestamp_decision) at release: checked at validation, at the optimistic gate (t_g) or the atomic commit (t_c), and by the release guard or a version-conditional controller command where these are used. It does not bound the physical completion of the action. Defaults to freshness_window_ms when absent.

preconditions.description: Contextual preconditions P over the context snapshot, declared by the producer. XAIR appends operator-mandated predicates for the action type (server-side policy).

safety_constraints.description: Hard constraints S declared by the producer, in the same predicate language and evaluated like preconditions; a false or unevaluable constraint revokes the intent. They are not certified safety functions, which remain in the PLC or safety controller.

priority.description: Higher values win conflicts on the same target in batch submissions and are dequeued first.

correlation_id.description: Opaque identifier recorded with the intent for audit; XAIR does not use it for coordination.

expr.description: Comparison Path Op Literal over the context, e.g. line.state == 'RUN'. Empty, ill-typed, unparsable or timed-out expressions and missing paths fail closed.

action_type.description: Requested action; selects the operator-mandated predicates of the server-side policy (matched case-insensitively).

target_entity.description: Resource the action acts on; at most one authorized, not yet committed or released intent per target.

parameters.description: Action-specific parameters, passed to the actuator unchanged except by a degradation policy.

degradation_policy.description: Fallback applied before authorization: reduce_speed halves parameters.speed_factor (default 1.0) and the transformed intent is revalidated under the same id.
